svg.title: Executed PyTorch learning-rate validation sweep
svg.desc: Six constant learning rates are compared after sixty epochs. Rate 1 has the lowest final validation loss. Curves for 0.0001, 1, and 10 show barely changing, useful, and unstable training paths.
